description: Save a card on file for reuse in future transactions (via card_id).

card.description: Card to store. `number` must already be encrypted.

number.description: Card number. PRE-ENCRYPTED by the rinne-js Card Element in the browser (format "ev:..."). Rinne rejects raw/plaintext card numbers and CVVs with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — there is no server-side encryption path. Run a rinne-js checkout flow first to obtain this token, then pass it here to finalize server-side. See get_sandbox_guide.

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID to scope this call to (uses /v1/merchants/{merchant_id}/...). Omit to act at the organization/self level with an org-scoped key.

name: store_card
